resolution.note: gh empty/truncated replies retry once then exit 71 naming the command (src/ci/gh-reply.ts)

title: Ship names an empty gh reply instead of exiting 74
body:
Why: on 2026-11-14 the t-4868c64 lane's first bin/krn pr ship exited 74 with 'unexpected end of JSON input' before the Check wait started (PR #801); a 74 means a red Check, so the exit lied about the cause.
Outcome: an empty or truncated gh JSON reply in ship (create/view/merge) is retried once and otherwise exits with a named transport exit and the gh command, never 74.
Proof: a ship test with a stubbed gh returning empty stdout asserts the named exit and message; npm run fast PASS.
